business_problem: Arcee needed to train and serve an open reasoning model strong enough for long-running agents and complex tool use, but had to do it at frontier scale without inheriting the high costs and lock-in associated with proprietary reasoning APIs.
solution_summary: Arcee trained its Trinity family of open-weight models on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra infrastructure so enterprises could run reasoning models they own, inspect, and fine-tune themselves. The company used 2,048 Blackwell Ultra GPUs for training, paired them with Quantum InfiniBand networking to keep expert-parallel communication efficient, and relied on NeMo open libraries for post-training and reinforcement-learning stages. In production, Dynamo and vLLM serve the resulting mixture-of-experts models so long-horizon agents can execute multistep workflows and tool calls at lower cost than closed alternatives. This stack lets Arcee combine frontier-scale pretraining, RL post-training, and cost-efficient inference in one architecture, turning an open model into a viable choice for agentic workloads that previously pushed enterprises toward proprietary APIs.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs
solution_components.role: Train Trinity models at frontier scale with enough bandwidth and memory for MoE workloads.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand
solution_components.role: Keeps large-scale MoE communication efficient across Arcee's training cluster.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo
solution_components.role: Supports post-training and reinforcement-learning workflows for Trinity-Large-Thinking.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Dynamo
solution_components.role: Optimizes production inference for long-running agent workloads.

solution_components.name: vLLM
solution_components.role: Works with Dynamo to serve Arcee's open reasoning models efficiently.

data_flow: Large-scale training data is processed across Blackwell GPU clusters, post-trained with NeMo-based RL workflows, and then served through Dynamo and vLLM so enterprises and developers can run open reasoning models for agentic tasks.
business_outcome: Arcee achieved roughly $0.90 per million output tokens, about 20x lower inference cost than leading closed reasoning models, and quickly drove trillions of tokens of real usage for its open models while retaining frontier-level performance for agentic workflows.
architecture_clues: Arcee trains a sparse mixture-of-experts model with large-scale expert parallelism on Blackwell Ultra hardware.
NeMo is used for chain-of-thought and agentic RL post-training rather than only pretraining.
Dynamo and vLLM are the production serving layer for long-running agent workloads.
